name: SMSDojo
author: smsdojo

sections.description:
FREE SMSDojo plugin is a WordPress plugin that allows you to send SMS notifications to your customers instantly when they place an order on your WooCommerce store. Throughout the buying process, you can keep them informed and engaged.

How to Send SMS Messages to Your WordPress Users using your own mobile phone & number

Features

Message with an authorization code
Order status notification
Payment notification
Delivery status notification
Notification of new products, discounts, and promotions
Integration options
Sending SMS, GROUP SMS, BULK SMS, AUTO REPLY, scheduling SMS

External services

This plugin connects to the SMSDojo service (https://smsdojo.io and https://app.smsdojo.io) in order to send and manage SMS messages from your WooCommerce store.

When you configure and use the plugin, the following data may be sent from your WordPress site to the SMSDojo service whenever an SMS is triggered:

  • Your SMSDojo device identifier and API key (to authenticate the request).
  • The recipient’s phone number.
  • The SMS message content.
  • Your site URL and site name.
  • Contextual order information needed to process the notification (for example: order ID, order status, and related metadata), depending on which WooCommerce event triggered the SMS.

These requests are required for the plugin to be able to deliver SMS notifications via your own mobile device and SIM card.

The SMSDojo service is provided by SMSDojo. You can review the service policies here:

  • Terms of Service: https://smsdojo.io/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://smsdojo.io/privacy-policy/

Configuration

Step #1: Create your account on SMSDojo.io. Our system comes with a FREE Plan for your business.
Step #2: Download and install the Android APP on your phone and sign in using your QR CODE to get ready to send SMS.
Step #3: Download and install the SMSDojo PLUGIN.
Step #4: Start sending your first text marketing campaign. With SMSDojo, you can compose and automate notifications directly from WooCommerce.

Development

The SMSDojo.io plugin is developed and maintained by smsdojoio. For any inquiries or support, please contact us at support@smsdojo.io.

Contributions

We welcome contributions to the SMSDojo.io plugin. If you have any suggestions, feature requests, or bug reports, please submit them to our GitHub repository: https://github.com/smsdojoio/smsdojo-io.

License

SMSDojo.io is licensed under the GNU General Public License v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smsdojo-io folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the SMSDojo.io plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > SMSDojo.io to configure the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
How do I obtain my SMSDojo.io device ID and API key?

To obtain your SMSDojo.io device ID and API key, please visit the SMSDojo.io website and sign up for an account. Once you have registered, you can find your device ID and API key in your account settings.

Is there any cost using SMSDojo.io?

SMSDojo.io has a Free Plan that covers the needs of most merchants. If your requirements are higher, you can upgrade to one of our Premium Plans.
An additional cost would be the SMS Plan from your network provider, which often includes unlimited SMS messages.

Is there a setup fee for SMS Gateway SMSDojo?

No, we do not charge any setup fee.

How much is one SMS?

Our service does not charge for SMS.
You utilize your own network provider’s unlimited SMS plan — a cheap and cost-effective solution for marketing, bulk SMS, and customer communication in your country.

What are the minimum requirements for the mobile device to run the gateway?

The SMSDojo gateway application can run on Android versions: KitKat, Lollipop, Marshmallow, Nougat, Oreo, Pie, 10, or later. Ensure your device runs one of the listed versions.

Why should I tie the phone to the service?

A phone is needed for sending SMS via your own SIM and phone number — your number, your brand identity.

Can I customize the SMS messages sent to customers?

Yes, you can customize the SMS templates for each trigger. Use the available variables to personalize the messages, such as the customer’s name and order details.
